title: With no filter, the total over a limited relationship includes the rows that match nothing

source.quote: the total shown for Weak Amount is different than the sum of individual brands
source.supports: the total is not the sum of the groups: unmatched rows are in the total and in no group

derivation: No filter is on Product, so nothing is propagated and all of Target is summed: 100 + 50 + 120 + 60 + 30 = 360. That is 30 (Footwear) more than the two groups of many-to-many-cardinality-filter-propagation, 220 + 110 = 330.
